name: Keypoint
summary: Melbourne ISP (Labyrinth Connections Pty Ltd, ACN 069 211 678) running labyrinth.net.au from the mid-1990s; consolidated many small ISPs; renamed Key Point Pty Ltd ~2002; acquired by Datafast (later EFTel) late 2003.

events.details: Labyrinth Connections Pty Ltd, Melbourne (ACN 069 211 678; same ACN as later Key Point Pty Ltd). labyrinth.net.au captured by the Wayback Machine from Nov 1996; site presented as 'Labyrinth Connections' through the 1990s.

Labyrinth took over Nexus Internet Services, Majestic Internet Services, Sprint Online, Southern Internet Services, SkyNet Services, SubNet Internet Services and Webnet Burnie within the prior 24 months (per About Us page). Sprint Online's site described itself as 'a division of Labyrinth Connections' by Feb 2000. Also absorbed Jade Communications Pty Ltd (ACN 071 725 856) ~mid-2000: jade.net.au's footer reverted from Jade's own company details (Level 2, 77 Southbank Blvd, South Melbourne; as late as 4 Mar 2000) to 'C/o Labyrinth Connections Pty Ltd ACN 069 211 678, Level 10, 99 Queen St Melbourne 3000, info@labyrinth.net.au' (by 17 Sep 2000); jade.net.au served a Labyrinth-KeyPoint redirection page by 30 Oct 2003.
